purpose: Teach: 付着/印鑑/コンペ/足場/自粛/増減/連覇/鉄人

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 製品に、本気で、絶対、ゴミ、絶対、付着しないよう、品質管理、絶対、徹底させろ、本気で、頼んだぞ、絶対、本気で。
lines.en: I need absolute certainty that no dust ever contaminates our products. Make quality control airtight. I'm counting on you.
lines.style: Commanding, clipped authority. Each phrase lands with weight. No warmth—just clarity and expectation. Slight forward lean in the posture of someone who has decided this matters.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。重要書類、本気で、絶対、印鑑、絶対、徹底しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We're maintaining rigorous protocols on every critical document and seal. Thank you for the directive.
lines.style: Steady, precise acknowledgment. Respectful but not deferential—the tone of someone who already knew this mattered and is confirming it's locked in. Slight nod in the voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界のコンペ、本気で、絶対、当社、絶対、勝ちにいけ、本気で、頼んだぞ、絶対、社員、皆、本気で、頑張れ、絶対、本気、絶対。
lines.en: This industry competition is ours to win. I need everyone—every single person—going all in. We're not just competing. We're dominating.
lines.style: Sharp opening, building intensity. The words push forward without rushing. Pride underneath the push—not arrogance, but earned confidence. Slight edge on 'everyone' to make sure it lands.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新工場の足場、本気で、絶対、安全管理、絶対、徹底しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Confirmed. Safety protocols at the new facility are being executed without exception. Every standard is being met.
lines.style: Factual, assured. Speaks like someone reporting on something already done, not something promised. Even pace, steady breath. The security of competence.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界で、本気で、絶対、自粛、絶対、必要な、時期、絶対、社員、絶対、お互いに、本気で、絶対、配慮しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ、絶対。
lines.en: The industry needs restraint right now. I need this team to show mutual respect and consideration—for each other, for the moment we're in. That's on all of us.
lines.style: Shift to something quieter, more measured. The authority doesn't disappear but it becomes thoughtful. Slight pause before 'that's on all of us'—like he's including himself. Less hammer, more gravitas.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。売上の増減、本気で、絶対、毎月、絶対、報告いたします、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We'll have monthly sales reports ready without fail. Your trust means everything to us.
lines.style: Professional warmth—still precise, but with genuine gratitude underneath. Not performative. Like someone who takes the responsibility seriously because they respect who's giving it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界で、本気で、絶対、連覇、絶対、目指せ、絶対、当社の、本気で、絶対、誇り、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: I want consecutive wins. That's what we're after. Not just winning once—winning again and again. That's what our company stands for.
lines.style: Conviction without theatrics. Steady pace, deliberate. Slight emphasis on 'again and again' like he's painting a picture of the future. The voice of someone who believes this is achievable.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員、本気で、絶対、鉄人レース、絶対、参加、絶対、応援、しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, sir. Our team is fully committed to the Iron Man Challenge—participating, supporting each other, giving everything we have.
lines.style: Warm closing note—not saccharine, but genuinely enthusiastic. Like he's proud to report this. Slightly lighter pace than before, but still grounded. The voice of someone pleased to deliver good news.
